snippet.title: CANIDAE Full Game Playthrough + All Endings
snippet.description:
CANIDAE is a short, indie horror visual novel about a gang of friends in animal masks going out on Halloween.

Developed by Ozone Interactive
Creative Commons music by Kevin MacLeod and Patricia Taxxon (soundtrack playlist on my channel).

I uploaded this just to have some video of the game up online, if you want to play it you can check it out on my Itch page here:
https://ozoneinteractive.itch.io/canidae

Ending 1: 00:00 - 27:19
Ending 2: 27:19 - 39:10

Socials:
https://linktr.ee/ozoneinteractive
